attribution: Reference lines are defined, not surveyed: the build walks each one across the projection and clips it to the country, so what is drawn is the projection's own curve.
_source: "join": "generated" means no file is fetched: each item describes its own line, and the engine reads the layer type, never this layer's name.
_float: A reference line is a wire stretched above the model, at the height of a 1,500 m hill, draped only where the land stands higher: drawn on the surface it was cut by every hill it crossed.
